integrity: Mathematical proofs and a reproducible independent finite enumeration are provided. Finite enumeration does not replace the infinite combinatorial proof.
scientific_limitations: The maximal rank is proved for all positive sizes, but the number of maximum-rank square-zero maps is not resolved for sizes congruent to two modulo four. Absolute priority is not certified.
title: A mod-four square-zero rank defect in parity-preserving fence inverse monoids
